metadata.title: Review Implementation Plan
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Read and understand the implementation plan produced by the plan-work-item sub-process. Use before starting implementation to understand scope, affected files, and step order.

output.description: Understood plan: scope, affected files, step order, dependencies, testing strategy

prerequisites: Implementation plan exists in parent process memory
specificActions: Read the implementation plan from parent process memory
Identify implementation step order and dependencies
Note testing strategy for later verification
bestPractices: Verify the plan is complete before starting implementation
Note any ambiguities that need clarification before coding
Understand the dependency order — don't implement out of sequence

substeps.name: Read implementation plan from parent memory
substeps.description: Load the plan produced by plan-work-item
actions: Note the plan structure and sections

substeps.name: Understand scope and affected files
substeps.description: Identify what files need to be created, modified, or deleted
actions: Review affected files table from the plan

substeps.name: Identify implementation order
actions: Note ordering: dependencies/config → module wiring → feature code → infra/DevOps → tests

substeps.name: Note testing strategy
actions: Review testing strategy from the plan

substeps.name: Store in memory
actions: Store planScope, affectedFiles, implementationOrder, testingStrategy in memory

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
actions: Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Read plan → understand scope → identify order → note testing → store in memory
